P-17.title: Early Warning
P-17.text: A loan with 3 or more early-warning signals within 90 days (revenue down >=15%, net cash flow negative for 2 consecutive periods, related company past due, collateral down >=10%, rising DPD) must be moved to the High Risk group and monitored monthly.

P-22.title: Collateral
P-22.text: When collateral value falls 10% or more from the latest valuation, the credit officer must request additional collateral or reduce the credit limit within 30 days.

P-31.title: Related Parties
P-31.text: If a related company or guarantor becomes past due (from 1 day), review contagion risk and reassess the customer's repayment capacity.

P-08.title: Disbursement Hold
P-08.text: A High Risk loan with DPD of 10 days or more and negative cash flow has further disbursements suspended until approved by the competent authority.
